metadata.article_title: Protection of action taken in good faith.

article.title: Protection of action taken in good faith.
article.content: No suit, prosecution or other legal proceedings shall lie against the Central Government, the Board, its Chairperson and any Member, officer or employee thereof for anything which is done or intended to be done in good faith under the provisions of this Act or the rules made thereunder.
article.html:
35Protection of action taken in good faith.

Section 35 · Chapter IX · page 20 of the Act

No suit, prosecution or other legal proceedings shall lie against the Central Government, the Board, its Chairperson and any Member, officer or employee thereof for anything which is done or intended to be done in good faith under the provisions of this Act or the rules made thereunder.
